claim_ceiling: Proposed mapping between OLI evidence/experiment contracts and NASA's community-owned life-detection knowledge/mission-planning resources; not an endorsed NASA integration or replacement.

source_resources.name: NASA Life Detection Knowledge Base (LDKB)
source_resources.contribution_model: user-developed arguments supported by literature evidence, with gaps identified for community completion

source_resources.name: NASA Life Detection Forum (LDF)
source_resources.purpose: connect life-detection objectives, evidence knowledge, measurement technologies and instrument requirements

source_resources.name: NASA Ladder of Life Detection
source_resources.constraints: not a definitive final product, not a universal ranking, and not an instrument or biosignature endorsement

source_resources.name: Life Detection Knowledge Base: A Community Tool for Knowledge Management and Representation
source_resources.contribution: describes a shared taxonomy, four standardized assessment dimensions, user-defined evidence arguments and links to measurement technologies and traceability

architecture_position.principle: Complement and interoperate; do not clone a community-maintained knowledge base or claim superiority on a different task.
nasa_strengths: Community-maintained knowledge and expert-authored scientific arguments
A biosignature taxonomy spanning chemistry, structure and activity
Explicit biological/abiotic prevalence and signal-strength dimensions
Science Traceability Tool linking science objectives to measurement and instrument requirements
Living resource that makes knowledge gaps visible
oli_differentiation_targets: Machine-executable typed evidence and observation contracts
Deterministic simulation controls and open-world adversarial benchmarks
Source/artifact digests, common-cause groups and independent replay receipts
Explicit spatial/temporal observability, sampling and detector calibration
Cross-project connections to physics simulation, spatial evidence and rights-aware provenance
non_claims: No NASA endorsement or partnership is implied.
No claim that LDKB is inferior, obsolete or a classifier.
No import of NASA community data without permission and source-level attribution.
No automatic conversion of the four LDKB criteria into a single probability of life.
No universal scalar ranking of life signatures.

conceptual_mapping.rule: Preserve the NASA taxonomy term and entry URI as external references; do not silently replace the taxonomy with the OLI substrate ontology.

conceptual_mapping.nasa_concept: literature argument supporting or opposing a biosignature
conceptual_mapping.rule: Represent support and contradiction as separate claims; distinct record IDs do not imply independent sources.

conceptual_mapping.oli_representation: environment-conditioned prior evidence and competing hypothesis context
conceptual_mapping.rule: Keep qualitative/quantitative/unknown values, source, environmental scope and uncertainty. Do not force unknown values to zero or one.

conceptual_mapping.nasa_concept: biological signal strength / abiotic signal strength
conceptual_mapping.oli_representation: observable response model + likelihood/calibration evidence + abiotic baseline
conceptual_mapping.rule: Do not confuse signal strength with posterior probability that life exists.

conceptual_mapping.oli_representation: ObservationCoverage + instrument capability evidence + calibration records
conceptual_mapping.rule: Include units, detection limits, reference abundance, detection probability, spatial footprint, cadence, sample preparation and known false-negative modes.

conceptual_mapping.oli_representation: science objective -> PropertyQuestion -> ObservablePrediction -> InterventionCandidate/MeasurementCandidate -> instrument constraints -> evidence obligation
conceptual_mapping.rule: Every proposal remains advisory; execution, sample acquisition and intervention require separate human/facility/legal authorization.

conceptual_mapping.oli_representation: external contextual framework reference plus environment-specific criteria
conceptual_mapping.rule: Do not use rung position as a universal life score or replace context-specific judgment with a global ranking.

external_identity.rule: Never discard external IDs or normalize away the source vocabulary.

claim.rule: A claim is not a measurement and not a truth label.

measurement.rule: Unknown measurement metadata stays unknown; no inferred capability.

experiment.rule: The experiment selector can rank proposals, not actuate instruments or contact entities.

provenance.rule: No bulk scraping or rehosting of community material. Record permissions and cite original entries.

benchmarks.task: Map selected NASA biosignature entries through objective, observable, measurement and instrument requirements without losing their external IDs or definitions.
benchmarks.acceptance: 100% of mapped records retain original URI/ID and source terminology; unmapped fields remain explicitly unknown.

benchmarks.task: Check whether biological/abiotic prevalence and signal-strength arguments have cited evidence and declared environment scope.
benchmarks.acceptance: No missing dimension is silently imputed; all gaps produce explicit evidence obligations.

benchmarks.task: Convert a selected evidence gap into a bounded, advisory experiment proposal with rival predictions, controls, observability and cost.
A separate evaluator reconstructs the evidence path from external entry through raw measurement, inference and experiment proposal.
benchmarks.acceptance: Every displayed conclusion is traceable to versioned evidence; disputed or unverified claims remain unresolved.

data_policy.intended_mode: user-authorized linking/citation or documented export/API if provided by the resource owner
